title: Kissed Brazilian Veal Skewers
description: Tender veal skewers marinated in a mixture of olive oil, garlic, and herbs, grilled to perfection in agave leaves, a kid-friendly Brazilian dish
instructions: Preheat grill to medium high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, oregano, thyme, salt, and black pepper.
Add the veal cubes to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated veal cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Wrap each skewer in an agave leaf, securing with a toothpick if needed.
Grill the skewers for 8 minutes, turning occasionally, until the veal is cooked through to an internal temperature of 145 degrees Fahrenheit.
Let the skewers rest for 5 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
